label: 3rd/4th original token in {k,n,p,o,2,l,h,r} after g/y/c/q/w/e/v/t
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at steps t=2 and t=3 (98.8% of mass; never at t=0,1 or t>=5, and almost never at the delimiter or in the copy phase). Within those steps it depends on the current token together with the previous one or two tokens, and the effect looks additive. The current input favors k, n, p, o, 2, then l, h, r (k and n have the most lift). The previous token favors g, y, c, q, w, e, v, t, and the token two back favors g, 0, 3, b, e, y. The largest activations are combinations like 0 g g [k] and 0 y g [n], with g or y just before k/n/p and often a leading 0. The step-and-current-token gate alone reaches 90% recall at 22% precision. Also requiring the previous token gives dev F1 0.55. Requiring the token two back too raises precision to 0.84 but cuts recall to 0.24. The weak-current-token cases I scored (e.g. i, s, v, d) rarely fire. Activation magnitude is small (max 0.055).
